newsitem.title: MALAWI: Malawi T-bill rate slides at fortnightly auction.
newsitem.headline: Malawi T-bill rate slides at fortnightly auction.

text.p: The average discount rate for Malawi's three-month Treasury Bills fell by 1.37 percentage points to 13.89 percent at the latest fortnightly tender from 15.26 percent two weeks ago, the Reserve Bank said on Thursday.
Applications for the 128.7 million kwacha of bills on offer totalled 40.7 million kwacha. Average price was 96.9 per cent.

The average rate for six-month bills dropped by 1.31 percentage points to 15.08 percent from 16.39 percent two weeks ago. Applications for the 87.9 million kwacha of bills on offer totalled 39.3 million kwacha. The average price was 95.113 per cent.

For nine-month bills, the average rate fell to 14.64 percent from 15.96 percent two weeks ago. Applications for the 139.5 million kwacha of bills on offer totalled 52.5 million kwacha at an average price of 92.8720 per cent.
